sanjay: hey @maria @linda — i addressed the comments from the review (serialization edge case + changelog). PTAL when you have a minute. I added a tiny smoke script at tools/smoke/llm_canary.sh and a short test dataset. Can someone be merge-owner for the canary slot i reserved tomorrow 10:00am PST? i can squash if that helps.
maria: thanks — will take a look in ~30. quick q: did you update the migration doc too or just the changelog?
sanjay: updated both. migration note under docs/migrations/2024-08-kv-serialize.md. also ran local smoke; output below:
```
$ ./tools/smoke/llm_canary.sh --quick
ok: health check passed
ok: sample request -> 200
PASS: end-to-end smoke
```
linda: nice. i can be merge-owner for the 10am slot. i skimmed the diff — one tiny nit in a comment but not blocking. prefer squashed commit for a cleaner rollout log.
sanjay: great — will squash and push now. pinging once done.
sanjay: done — rebased + squashed into one commit and force-pushed:
```
$ git rebase -i origin/main~1
# squash commits
$ git push -f origin sanjay/kv-serialize-fix
```
maria: running CI checks now, looks like one flaky test popped earlier in master build but not from this change. i'll approve once CI green.
deploy-bot: canary slot reserved: 2024-08-15 18:00 UTC (10:00am PST) — slot id cslot-8732
maria: CI passed ✅ — LGTM from me. @linda are you still good to merge at 10?
linda: yep, merging at slot start and monitoring logs. thanks @sanjay for the quick follow-up :thumbsup:
sanjay: thanks y'all — appreciate the quick turnaround :rocket:
